## Import libraries and files

```{r}
library(STdeconvolve)
source("../functions(new).R")

result = readRDS("../../Data/Isoform/Simulation/results/initialRes/initialOutput.rds")
gt_deconv = readRDS("../../Data/Isoform/Simulation/gt_celltype_compositions.rds")
gt_gene_exp = readRDS("../../Data/Isoform/Simulation/reference.rds")
pos = readRDS("../../Data/Isoform/Simulation/gt_pos.rds")
isoform_dict = readRDS("../../Data/Isoform/Simulation/isoform_dict.rds")
gt_isoform_prob = readRDS("../../Data/Isoform/Simulation/gt_isoform_prob.rds")
```


# Deconvolution

```{r}
deconv_prop = result$gamma/rowSums(result$gamma)
rownames(deconv_prop) = rownames(gt_deconv)
colnames(deconv_prop) = colnames(gt_deconv)
```

# Cell type gene expression matrix comparison

```{r}
comparison_matrix = matrix(0, nrow = 2*nrow(gt_gene_exp), ncol = ncol(gt_gene_exp))
idx = 1
for (i in 1:nrow(gt_gene_exp)) {
  comparison_matrix[idx,] = gt_gene_exp[i,]
  comparison_matrix[idx+1,] = result$tau[i,]/sum(result$tau[i,])
  idx = idx + 2
}
rownames(comparison_matrix) = c("GT C1", "Estimated C1",
                                "GT C2", "Estimated C2",
                                "GT C3", "Estimated C3",
                                "GT C4", "Estimated C4",
                                "GT C5", "Estimated C5",
                                "GT C6", "Estimated C6")
visualize_reference(comparison_matrix, want_log=F, cluster_col=F)
```

# Isoform prob
```{r}
interested_gene_pool = c()
for (i in 1:length(isoform_dict)) {
  if (length(isoform_dict[[i]]) > 1) {
    interested_gene_pool = c(interested_gene_pool, i)
  }
}
sample_size = 20
max_unique_isoform = 5
gene_sample = sample(interested_gene_pool, sample_size)
num_cell_type = nrow(gt_gene_exp)

isoform_as_array = matrix(0, nrow = num_cell_type * sample_size * 3, 
                          ncol = max_unique_isoform)
isoform_pos_x = rep(rep(seq(1:sample_size),each=3), num_cell_type)*3
isoform_pos_y = c(rep(c(2,4,6),sample_size),rep(c(10,12,14),sample_size),
                  rep(c(18,20,22),sample_size),rep(c(26,28,30),sample_size),
                  rep(c(34,36,38),sample_size),rep(c(42,44,46),sample_size))*(-1)
isoform_pos = data.frame(x=isoform_pos_x,y=isoform_pos_y)

k = 1
for (i in 1:num_cell_type) {
  for (j in 1:sample_size) {
    vec = numeric(max_unique_isoform)
    vec[1:length(gt_isoform_prob[[i,gene_sample[j]]])] = gt_isoform_prob[[i,gene_sample[j]]]
    isoform_as_array[k,] = vec; k = k+1;
    for (m in 1:length(isoform_dict[[gene_sample[j]]])) {
      vec[m] = result$f[i,paste("g",gene_sample[j],"i",m,sep="")]
    }
    isoform_as_array[k,] = vec
    k = k + 1;
    isoform_as_array[k,1] = gt_gene_exp[i,gene_sample[j]]/sum(gt_gene_exp[,gene_sample[j]])
    isoform_as_array[k,2] = 1-gt_gene_exp[i,gene_sample[j]]/sum(gt_gene_exp[,gene_sample[j]])
    k = k + 1
  }
}

vizAllTopics(isoform_as_array, isoform_pos, r=1, showLegend=F)
```

```{r}
gene_picked = 110
gene_names = paste("g",gene_picked,isoform_dict[[gene_picked]],sep="")
our_estimation = result$f[,gene_names]

check_matrix = matrix(0, nrow=nrow(our_estimation), ncol=ncol(our_estimation))
for (i in 1:nrow(check_matrix)) {
  check_matrix[i,] = gt_isoform_prob[,gene_picked][[i]]  
}
colnames(check_matrix) = colnames(our_estimation)
rownames(check_matrix) = rownames(our_estimation)
print("Ground Truth")
print(check_matrix)
print("Our Estimation")
print(our_estimation)


```
